from: The game's shell on Babylon.js 9.18.0: the film's ranger (models/intro.ranger.glb) through createCharacterPool (characterModel.ts) under a NullEngine, standing at the origin. poses: after instance.pose(clip, seconds), the world matrix (worldOf, scene/sceneStage.ts) of every node of the file that the instance has a joint by the name of, sixteen floats a node, in the order of nodes (the file's node numbers) and names. blends: the same after instance.pose(clip, seconds, blend), the last with no blend. roots: the ranger posed at drive, 2 s, its root stood at root and turned yaw about +y: where its chest joint then is (worldOf(joint).getTranslation())
